title: dep-scan mcp list_findings output
description: The document the list_findings tool of `depscan mcp` returns: one page of findings that match the filters, with nextCursor when more pages remain, or, when even one page would exceed the server's response budget, the spill envelope with the file the page was written to and the number of findings in it. The two shapes are never mixed.

items.description: One finding of the scan, as the finding schema defines it. When the finding's exploitability carries a witness, it is the id of the evidence record whose witness path the reach verdict names, in the scan's evidence store.

findings.description: The findings of this page, in scan order.

nextCursor.description: The cursor to pass as the next call's cursor argument to read the page after this one. Present only when more findings remain.

oneOf.title: the result spilled to a file

file.description: The absolute path, with / separators, of the file the result was written to, inside the scan directory's mcp/ directory. The file name is the tool name followed by the SHA-256 digest of the canonical arguments.

count.description: The number of findings the spilled file holds.
